articles.title: Runway's open-source Praxis-1 turns video AI into a robot controller
articles.summary: Runway releases its robotics model Praxis-1 with open weights and source code under the Apache 2.0 license. The model uses knowledge from video training for robot control and leads the World Action Model category on Nvidia's RoboLab-120 benchmark. It can't yet plan complex action sequences on its own, though. The article Runway's open-source Praxis-1 turns video AI into a robot controller app

articles.title: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them
articles.summary: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images the way other AI models do. Instead of computing pixels, the language model writes Python code that places hundreds of thousands of simulated brushstrokes on a virtual canvas, complete with bristle texture and paint application. A single photorealistic parking garage scene took roughly 700,000 strokes, according to Anthropic employee Jake Eaton.

articles.title: OpenAI reassigns robotics researchers to other teams as general-purpose models might make specialized robotics AI unnecessary
articles.summary: OpenAI is dissolving its standalone robotics team for the second time, but not because it lacks data. General-purpose models like GPT-6 Astra can apparently control robots directly, making a dedicated unit unnecessary.
